shim.definition: n. a thin wedge of material (wood or metal or stone) for driving into crevices
shim.translation:
n. 填片, 万能开锁片
vt. 用填片填

shima.translation: [地名] [尼泊尔] 希马; [地名] [日本] 志摩

shimada.translation: 岛田(地名, 在日本, 东经 138º10' 北纬 34º50')

shimizu.translation: n. 清水（财富500强公司之一, 总部位于日本, 主要经营工程建筑）

shimmed.definition:
past participle of shim
n. a thin wedge of material (wood or metal or stone) for driving into crevices
shimmed.translation:
(shim 的过去分词) n. 填片, 万能开锁片

shimmer.definition:
n. a weak and tremulous light
v. shine with a weak or fitful light
v. give off a shimmering reflection, as of silk
shimmer.translation:
n. 微光, 闪光
vi. 闪烁
vt. 使闪烁

shimmered.translation: v. 闪闪发光, 发微光( shimmer的过去式和过去分词 )

shimmering.definition:
v shine with a weak or fitful light
v give off a shimmering reflection, as of silk
shimmering.translation: v. 闪闪发光, 发微光( shimmer的现在分词 )

shimmers.definition:
n a weak and tremulous light
v shine with a weak or fitful light
v give off a shimmering reflection, as of silk
shimmers.translation:
n. 闪闪发光, 发微光( shimmer的名词复数 )
v. 闪闪发光, 发微光( shimmer的第三人称单数 )

shimmey.translation:
n. 西迷舞, 摇动
v. 摇动,震颤,晃动

shimmied.definition:
v tremble or shake
v dance a shimmy
shimmied.translation: v. 摇动, 震颤, 晃动( shimmy的过去式和过去分词 )

shimmies.definition:
n an abnormal wobble in a motor vehicle (especially in the front wheels)
n a woman's sleeveless undergarment
n lively dancing (usually to ragtime music) with much shaking of the shoulders and hips
v tremble or shake
v dance a shimmy
shimmies.translation:
n. 西迷舞, 摇动( shimmy的名词复数 )
v. 摇动, 震颤, 晃动( shimmy的第三人称单数 )

shimmy.definition:
n. an abnormal wobble in a motor vehicle (especially in the front wheels)
n. lively dancing (usually to ragtime music) with much shaking of the shoulders and hips
v. tremble or shake
shimmy.translation:
n. (非正式)女式衬衣, (美)不正常振动
vi. (美)摇晃, 振动, 颤动

shimmying.definition:
v tremble or shake
v dance a shimmy
shimmying.translation: v. 摇动, 震颤, 晃动( shimmy的现在分词 )

shimon.translation: n. (Shimon)人名；(日)施门(名)；(塞、以)希蒙

shimonoseki.translation: 下关[日本本州岛西南岸港市](即马关)
